Name: Event Countdown
Author: Ratpack

Actions.Name: Countdown
Actions.Tooltip: Counts down to any date. Turns amber under 24h, pulses red under 1h, and celebrates when it arrives.

Description: Beautiful per-key countdowns to any future date — game launches, holidays, stream anniversaries. Amber under a day, pulsing red under an hour, a celebration when it lands. No internet required.
